title: Breezy Blue
meta_description: Find the perfect Seagrove Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Breezy Blue’, a luxury 5 bedroom, 5 full & 3 half bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Gulf Views & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memora
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach | Approximately 200 Feet to Deeded Beach Access - Majestic Gulf Views - Private pool (Heating available for an additional $60 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) - Game & Media Room - Fenced Back Yard - Outdoor Grilling Station & Dining - Six Adult Bikes Included - Six seater Golf Cart included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18): FIRST FLOOR: • Primary Bedroom 1: King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities & tile/glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Primary Bedroom 2: King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities & tile/glass Shower + soaking tub • Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower • Bunk room 4: Queen over Queen bunks (sleeps up to 8) – ensuite bathroom single vanity shower/tub combo • Queen sleeper sofa: (sleeps 2) THIRD FLOOR • Primary Bedroom 5 : King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities, large Shower glass & tile + soaking tub This newly constructed vacation rental in Seagrove Beach boasts breathtaking Gulf views and is conveniently located just a short stroll from beach access, enhanced by a six-seater golf cart and bicycles for your use. The stunning backyard features a private pool that is perfect for refreshing swims on warm days, along with a spacious fenced-in area that is ideal for enjoying a fun game of cornhole while you prepare delicious meals in the outdoor summer kitchen. After dinner, guests can retreat to the top floor, where adults can relax on the covered balcony and marvel at the stunning sunset over the Gulf. Children will be thoroughly entertained with a variety of options, including a flat-screen TV, a Sonos sound system, a game table for family fun, and an arcade console loaded with hundreds of classic video games. For those eager to explore, the included golf cart and six adult bikes provide effortless access to the iconic Seaside as well as the many charming coastal communities that line beautiful 30A. If you are searching for an extraordinary vacation rental on 30A, Breezy Blue is guaranteed to leave a memorable impression. Restaurants Nearby: Cafe Thirty-A (Fine Dining - Great Happy Hour) Perfect Pig (Casual) Brozinni’s Pizzeria (Casual) Dough-Sea-Dough Donuts Goatfeathers Seafood Market Prema Organic Cafe Surfing Deer (Fine Dining) Seagrove Village Market (Casual) Pizza by the Sea (Casual) Old Florida Fish House (Casual) Convenient Location: Publix Grocery (Bike or Golf Cart) Seaside (approximately 1 mile) Less than a mile from Highway 395 Access Highway 98 to Destin or Panama City Beach Walmart Market & Pharmacy 7.2 Miles on Hwy 98
